IDEA: prefix_successor_ball
TITLE: Prefix-conditioned successor barycentres for curved residual assignment
MOTIVATION: At the third token, items sharing the first two codes may still have competing next-item futures. A single global successor signal misses this local branching; the residual code should identify an item by its successor distribution conditional on its already-assigned prefix.
NOVELTY: Unlike first-level cohort anchoring or ordering an extension token by successor rank, this constructs training-only successor prototypes inside each (T1,T2) residual cell and uses their hyperbolic distance directly to select T2/T3 codes. The curve changes emitted residual codes, not just a side loss or code order.
CHANGE: Keep baseline Euclidean L1 quantization cheap. At L2/L3, assign each item's residual jointly against a candidate code using a Poincare distance to a learned successor-distribution prototype indexed by the current prefix and candidate residual code; blend that with residual reconstruction distance.
SPECIFICATION: Precompute sparse train-only transition distributions p_j(k)=(N_{jk}+alpha*pi(k))/(N_j+alpha), with pi the train item frequency distribution. During each hard-quantization refresh, form q_i=log(p_i+eps) projected to d dimensions by a fixed seeded sparse projection. For prefix a=(c1,c2), candidate code c at level l in {2,3}, maintain prototype u_{a,l,c}=normalized EMA mean of q_j for training items j assigned (a,c) at that level; shrink to global level prototype with weight n/(n+tau). Cost for item i: J(i,c)=||r_i-e_{l,c}||^2 + lambda_l*s_i*d^2_{-1}(Exp_0^(-c_curv)(Aq_i), Exp_0^(-c_curv)(u_{a,l,c})); assign argmin over the existing codebook. Implement actual curvature -c_curv (initial c_curv=1, fixed); do not alter code counts or L1. Use current-epoch assignments, then EMA prototypes, for the next refresh.
COST: One sparse train transition pass O(E_train), one fixed projection per item, and refresh-time prototype accumulation O(24556*d); per optimizer step only O(B*K*d) for L2/L3 candidate distances (K=256, d small) if refreshed, or none between refreshes.
